title: Home-Scale Rates by Contract Price for Systems Settlements, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
A systems-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries a home-scale multiplier, applied to the program's cash-in-lieu maximum in the scheduled systems settlement.

**Rule.** The home-scale multiplier follows the contract price on the home's Home Purchase Agreement: USD 700000 or more takes 1.20; USD 500000 or more but under USD 700000 takes 1.10; under USD 500000 takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Contract price on the Home Purchase Agreement | Home-scale multiplier |
|---|---|
| USD 700000 or more | 1.20 |
| USD 500000 to under USD 700000 | 1.10 |
| under USD 500000 | 1.00 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical prices).** USD 700000 exactly takes 1.20; USD 699999 takes 1.10; USD 500000 exactly takes 1.10; USD 499999 takes 1.00.

The price read is the contract price of the purchase agreement under which Calloway sold the home that carries the coverage.
